blocks.content: An Ombudsman is an independent authority appointed to investigate complaints against public authorities. The concept originated in Sweden.
An Ombudsman is an independent authority appointed to investigate complaints against public authorities.

items: Origin of Ombudsman: Frequently tested in Indian competitive exams; the concept originated in Sweden.
Nature of Authority: Always remember that the Ombudsman operates as an independent body to ensure impartial investigation into public maladministration.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: An Ombudsman is an independent authority created to address public grievances.
The primary duty of an Ombudsman is investigating complaints directed at public authorities.
The institutional concept of the Ombudsman historically originated in Sweden.
